description: Pilot and Aircrew Curriculum Revision and Maintenance (PACRM) Multiple Award Contract (MAC) Ceiling Increase Synopsis posted 07 May 2025-THIS IS A NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD SOLE SOURCE AND IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS. Special Notice Pilot and Aircrew Curriculum Revision and Maintenance Multiple Award Contract INTRODUCTION: Naval Air Warfare Center Training Systems Division (NAWCTSD) Orlando, FL, to meet fleet requirements and to avoid unacceptable delays, intends to increase the Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (ID/IQ) contract ceiling of the Pilot and Aircrew Curriculum Revision and Maintenance (PACRM) Multiple Award Contract (MAC).
